CustomField.description: Start of the current calibration period, derived rather than typed. § 37 Abs. 1 Satz 2 MessEG starts it at Inverkehrbringen; § 34 Abs. 1 MessEV overrides that with the Tag der Eichung once the device has been re-calibrated. Two branches, one field, no data entry. The two harsher branches - a late Nacheichung backdating to the old period's end, and a device unused for over a year - need chronology and live in EichrechtService.
CustomField.label: Fristbeginn
